---
title: "3 · MNIST: Training a Network by Hand"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

We work through the classification of MNIST digits in detail. After the feed-forward pass we derive the parameter updates of the output layer and of the hidden layer analytically and check them against automatic differentiation. We then train the same network with a single output and the mean squared error, and with ten outputs and the categorical cross-entropy, and compare the two.
